description: This file contains wrapper functions for nl80211 Wi-Fi management operations, including sending management frames, setting interface types, and retrieving interface and station info, specific to the nl80211 implementation.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_sendManagementFrameCmd
methods.description: Sends a management frame via nl80211, using parameters from the endpoint and frame control structures.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_setSta
methods.description: Sets the interface type for the endpoint to station mode.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_set4Mac
methods.description: Configures whether the interface uses 4 MAC addresses.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_getInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves interface information for the endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_getStationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves station information for a given MAC address associated with the endpoint.
